obstacle: Barred mesquite door. The key is hidden in another room. Breaking it down takes time and makes noise.
Sheer sandstone climb. Without rope, mice risk exhaustion or falling.
Chamber whose only exit is in the centre of the ceiling, 6" from any wall.
Wind-whistle crack that shrieks without end. Each Turn spent here or in adjacent rooms gives a Frightened Condition.
Tunnel choked with sand, leaving a gap too small to crawl through.
Cistern passage completely filled with water.
Wide drift of loose sand. Gives an Exhausted Condition per 6" traveled.
trap: Adobe slab chiselled loose from its frame. A wedge behind it tips it forward when the latch is lifted.
Puddled corridor strung with copper wire, wired to a human battery in an alcove.
Dark tunnel filled with sulfur gas from a mud pot. Strong rotten-egg smell. d20 damage if ignited.
Rotten rope bridge over a deep shaft. Safe if crossed slowly, one at a time.
Pit blocking the way. A rattlesnake is asleep at the bottom.
Door with three cactus-shaped handles: one safe, two hiding spines dipped in venom. Venomous handles deal d12 damage.
Whirling ring of dust with a young mouse dancing inside. Those within beg desperately for others to join.
Floor painted with fresh pine pitch. A STR save pulls a foot loose.
puzzle: Floor of copper sheeting, scorching hot under a skylight. A piece of valuable treasure sits in the centre.
Three corked bottles of different-coloured tonic. Each is harmless alone but powerful or dangerous when mixed.
A block of salt crystal with a magic sword sealed inside. It is very hard, but dissolves in fresh water, and water is scarce here.
Treasure is at the bottom of a deep, dry well.
Large tin washtub, upside down. Treasure is taped to the inside of the tub.
Baited mousetrap. The lever is wired to a support beam and will collapse the tunnel if triggered.

spells: Fireball
Shoot a fireball up to 24". Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to all creatures within 6".
Leave in the heart of a burning brushfire for three days and nights.
Heal
Heal [SUM] STR damage and remove the Injured Condition from a creature.
Cut self for d6 STR damage, sprinkle the spell with the blood.
Magic Missile
Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to a creature within sight.
Drop from the top of a mesa. Touch the spell within one Turn.
Fear
Give the Frightened Condition to [DICE] creatures.
Receive the Frightened Condition from a hostile creature while carrying the spell.
Darkness
Create a [SUM] x 2" diameter sphere of pure darkness for [DICE] Turns.
Leave uncovered at the bottom of a mine shaft for three days.
Restore
Remove Exhausted or Frightened Condition from [DICE] + 1 creatures.
Bury beside a desert spring for three days.
Be Understood
Make your meaning clear to [DICE] creatures of another species for [DICE] Turns.
Give away freely to a creature of another species.
Ghost Beetle
Create an illusory beetle that can carry 6 inventory slots for [DICE] x 6 Turns.
Bury in a cattle graveyard for three nights.
Light
Force [DICE] creatures to make a WIL save or become stunned. Alternately, create light as bright as a torch for [SUM] turns.
Lay out on the salt flats from sunrise to sunset for three days.
Invisible Ring
Creates [DICE] x 6" ring of force. It is invisible and immovable. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Build an iron ring the same size as last cast. Pass the spell through it. Dissolves the ring.
Knock
Open a door or container, as if a Save were made with STR score of 10 + [DICE] x 4.
Lock in a strongbox, inside a strongbox, inside a strongbox. Leave for three days.
Grease
Cover [DICE] x 6" area in slippery, flammable grease. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save or fall prone.
Rub all over with rendered fat. Leave in the sun until it turns rancid.
Grow
Grow a creature to [DICE] + 1 times its original size for 1 Turn.
Leave on the top of a saguaro for three days.
Invisibility
Make creature invisible for [DICE] Turns. Any movement reduces duration by 1 Turn.
Go a day without opening your eyes once, while holding the spell.
Coyote Lure
Turn object into an irresistible lure for coyotes. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Give a coyote a gift it truly desires.
